name: kb_feedback
description: Downvote a KB entry that proved wrong in practice: { id, reason, role? }. Marks the entry stale=1 + flagged_for_review=1 and appends an ASCII feedback note "[feedback <ISO>] <validated-role>: <reason>" (CONTENT_CAP respected). NEVER deletes and NEVER touches confidence -- a downvoted CONFIRMED entry stays CONFIRMED-but-stale-flagged; the human resolves it in kb-review, this tool only flags it for that review. Exception: an ACTIVE user-directive is flagged for review but NOT staled (directives outrank agent experience -- the human decides); a pending directive proposal stales normally.
